audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Lucian Levels 3 and 4-5, calls First item 'Skill', and the full layer hands 2+ items to 'Lucian carry' while the content layer already says Garen wins it. The packet chart is Lucian / Lucian / Garen x5.
audit.why: Garen wins 54.63% over 6846 games — the largest sample in this slice — and the 'why' strings on those rows already argue Garen's case ('Level 3 your Q silence flips it', 'Levels 4-5 your E rotation grinds through', 'First item your W resists and regen let you eat poke and all-in'). Only the side tokens disagree, and the two layers contradict each other at 2+ items.
audit.corrected: Flipped win[2], win[3], win[5] and phases[2], [3], [5], [6] side/rating as one group; Levels 1 and 2 stay Lucian's.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5].t prices Relentless Pursuit at 14s and treats it as a fixed timer; diff says FAV but diffRating reads 7/10 with a red tone.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14 — 16s at rank 1 — and Lightslinger attacks reduce it, so the dash comes back faster the more he is auto-attacking. Waiting on a fixed 14s clock gets you dashed on. And a 54.63% lane is not 7/10 hard.
audit.corrected: Rewrote report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, and set diffRating 4.5/10 with a green tone and real difficulty strings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple fields treat Decisive Strike's silence as if it shuts Lucian off entirely — 'a Q silence shuts off his Piercing Light and E dash', 'a Q silence to shut down his Piercing Light burst'.
audit.why: Silence denies ability casts. It does not stop basic attacks, and Lucian's damage runs through Lightslinger — every ability he already cast leaves a double-shot queued, and his autos keep firing through the silence. A player who thinks the silence disarms him will stand in a full auto rotation. Courage's damage reduction, not the silence, is what makes the step-in survivable.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[2].text to say the silence stops spells but not Lightslinger.
